Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the most important safety test as "cost efficiency in material selection" (Option B). This is an error because the question explicitly asks for the **most important test for safety purposes**, which is clearly "maximum load the bridge can support" (Option A). While cost considerations are important in bridge design, they are secondary to ensuring the bridge can safely handle the loads it will encounter in real-world usage. This misunderstanding of the task's focus on safety led to the incorrect conclusion.
